summary: The main article describes a dual photochemical/nickel-mediated decarboxylative cross-coupling strategy using Hantzsch ester as a photoreductant and EDA complex activator. The document includes optimization data in Table 1, a broad substrate scope in Scheme 2, and detailed mechanistic investigations including UV/vis studies and stoichiometric experiments.

items.description: This scheme provides context for traditional cross-couplings and introduces the proposed EDA complex platform for Ni-mediated bond formation.
